::: {.hero}
# Mike Premer
[Assistant Professor of Forest Management · School of Forest Resources, University of Maine]{.lead}
:::

I lead the [Maine Forest Management Laboratory](https://maineforestlab.com), where we combine remote sensing, data science, and operational research to support forest management in a changing Acadian forest. This site collects my open-source software, data tools, and publications.

**Research themes**

- Digital soil, site, and vegetation mapping
- Uneven-aged, mixed-species management
- Restoration and adaptive tending strategies
- Diversification of forested stands, goods, and products
- Decision support tools and interdisciplinary collaboration
